label: Civic Commons Tragedy
desc: A Belief within safetyist discourse that the erosion of the information ecosystem constitutes a collective loss of societal value. Encompasses: Erosion of public trust, decline in civic engagement, and loss of shared fact-based reporting. Excludes: Individual economic loss or corporate competition.
